purpose: Qualify future SADC TCIB corridors by participant pair, operating model, FX, funding, settlement and recourse without claiming live access.

source_register.title: Payments Ecosystem Modernisation Programme
supports: PayShap and TCIB are distinct low-value domestic/regional payment paths
PEM includes a future pre-funded fast-payment model and broader participation ambitions
does_not_support: A named live TCIB corridor participant pair
A current TCIB transaction cap or customer tariff

source_register.title: Rewiring Payments: Open. Connected. Inclusive.
supports: SARB intends to move qualifying regional transactions up to R100000 to TCIB by late April 2027
SARB aims for an eight-country TCIB hub-and-spoke pilot by October 2027
does_not_support: Specific participant, pricing, currency or settlement arrangements

source_register.title: Enhancing Cross-border Payments: Fast Payment System Interlinking
supports: FPS links require coordinated technical and payment messaging standards, operational frameworks, rules, governance and oversight
Cross-border access, operating arrangements, screening and fraud information exchange are material to customer outcomes
does_not_support: A South African TCIB participant or corridor is live
A specific corridor's FX, funding or finality profile

source_register.title: Linking fast payment systems across borders: governance and oversight
supports: FPS interlinking requires decisions on legal setup, ownership, operations, participants, settlement models/assets, currencies, FX/PvP and liquidity/funding
does_not_support: A presumption that TCIB has PvP or prefunding support in a specific currency pair

corridor_profiles.notes: Domestic PayShap reference only; cannot be promoted into a cross-border TCIB capability.
R100000 is a future programme target expressed in ZAR minor units, not a current product limit. The eight-country hub-and-spoke objective is not a live corridor.
Entirely synthetic test pair; proves evaluator behavior, not real participant admission, currency support or access to TCIB.
